o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اشتمك (eşitmäk). Cognate with Turkish işitmek, Kazakh есту (estüw), Uzbek eshitmoq.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish طالمق (dalmaq), from Proto-Common Turkic *tāl- (“to sink or to lose strength, to faint, lose consciousness”).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *kïlï̄č (“sword”). Cognate with Turkish and Gagauz kılıç.
Partial calque of Classical Persian کَدْخُدَا (kadxudā, “kadkhoda”), from kənd (“village”) + xuda (“master, lord”).
